@@ -1,1 +1,8 @@
 def change
+# API keys
+
+Keys are stored as HMAC digests; a leaked database dump does not leak usable keys.
+
+## Rotating secret_key_base
+
+Rotation invalidates every key. Announce it first.
 end

overview: This illustrative docs PR forks from the API-key PR, beside the revoke PR rather than above it. It adds a runbook whose
states as fact what the API-key PR's introduction could only infer. Nothing here changes code.

topics.title: The rotation warning
paragraphs: The runbook says rotating secret_key_base invalidates every key. That follows from TokenDigest keying HMAC with the secret, but only if lookup recomputes the digest, and the lookup path is not in any PR of this stack. Confirm it before the runbook ships.
